name: starter-stance-retreat-rally
description: Smoke check only (starter content, says nothing about gameplay): three tanks far out with retreat at 50%, no repair building: hurt to 35% they pull back to the rally point in front of the base and park there. A move order of the player wins: they go where they are sent, and only once the 15 s are over they pull back again (from the middle of the player's move, which must not take over again).
steps: until not atsnapshot tanks as=front tol=150 max=300
expect not atsnapshot tanks as=parked tol=150
until atsnapshot tanks as=parked tol=150 max=1800
log: ^ASSIST stance set mask=2 value=2 percent=50 for 3 units

log.match: ^ASSIST stance retreat: unit \d+ at 35% goes to the rally point
^ASSIST stance retreat: unit \d+ parks at the rally point
^ASSIST stance retreat: unit \d+ takes the order of the player
